def trace(I,start,d):
    g=[r[:] for r in I]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=bgc]
    mc=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==mc}
    band=[c for c in others if c!=mc][0]
    def free(i_,j_): return 0<=i_<H and 0<=j_<W and (i_,j_) not in pts and g[i_][j_]!=band
    seen=set(); path=[];i_,j_=start;d=list(d);n=0
    while n<4*H*W:
        n+=1; key=(i_,j_,tuple(d))
        if key in seen: return None   # loop -> invalid
        seen.add(key)
        ni,nj=i_+d[0],j_+d[1]
        if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): break
        if (ni,nj) in pts: break
        if g[ni][nj]==band:
            a_row=(ni, nj+d[1]); a_col=(ni+d[0], nj)
            fr, fc = free(a_row[0],a_row[1]), free(a_col[0],a_col[1])
            if fr and not fc: d=[d[0],-d[1]]
            elif fc and not fr: d=[-d[0],d[1]]
            else: d=[-d[0],-d[1]]
            continue
        if g[ni][nj]!=bgc: break
        path.append((ni,nj)); i_,j_=ni,nj
    return path

    mc=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]==mc)
    dr=(pts[1][0]-pts[0][0]); dc=(pts[1][1]-pts[0][1])
    sd=(dr//abs(dr) if dr else 0, dc//abs(dc) if dc else 0)
    exp={(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(O) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==3}

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def simulate2(I,start,d):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=bgc]
    mc=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); band=max([c for c in others if c!=mc],key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==mc}
    def fr(i_,j_): return 0<=i_<H and 0<=j_<W and I[i_][j_] not in (band,mc)
    p=[];i_,j_=start;d=list(d)
    for _ in range(4*(H+W)):
        ni,nj=i_+d[0],j_+d[1]
        if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): break
        if (ni,nj) in pts: 
            p.append((ni,nj)); break
        if I[ni][nj]==band:
            hz=fr(ni,nj+d[1]); vz=fr(ni+d[0],nj)
            if hz and not vz: d=[d[0],-d[1]]
            elif vz and not hz: d=[-d[0],d[1]]
            else: d=[-d[0],-d[1]]
            continue
        if I[ni][nj]!=bgc: break
        p.append((ni,nj)); i_,j_=ni,nj
    return p,p[-1] if p else None

    I=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    exp={(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(O) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==3}
    # brute: all (start on boundary, dir) sims whose set==exp
    hits=[]
    for si in range(H):
        for sj in [0,len(I[0])-1]:
            for di,dj in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]:
                p,end=simulate2(I,(si,sj),(di,dj))
                if set(p)==exp and end in pts: hits.append(((si,sj),(di,dj)))
    print('demo',k,hits[:5])

def traj(I,E,d,maxsteps=200):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=bgc]
    mc=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); band=max([c for c in others if c!=mc],key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==mc}
    def fr(i_,j_): return 0<=i_<H and 0<=j_<W and I[i_][j_] not in (band,mc)
    p=[];i_,j_=E;d=list(d)
    for _ in range(maxsteps):
        ni,nj=i_+d[0],j_+d[1]
        if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): return None  # exited
        if (ni,nj) in pts: return p   # ended at marker
        if I[ni][nj]==band:
            hz=fr(ni,nj+d[1]); vz=fr(ni+d[0],nj)
            if hz and not vz: d=[d[0],-d[1]]
            elif vz and not hz: d=[-d[0],d[1]]
            else: d=[-d[0],-d[1]]
            continue
        if I[ni][nj]!=bgc: return None
        p.append((ni,nj)); i_,j_=ni,nj
    return None  # ran out

for k in range(1,9):

                if t is not None and set(t)==exp: sols.append(((si,sj),(di,dj)))
    print('demo',k,'unique sols:',sols[:3],'n=',len(sols),'exp n=',len(exp))
